name: Drupal Test Assertions
description: A test-only library of reusable PHPUnit assertion traits for Drupal functional/kernel tests, providing Drupal-aware assertions for fields, entities, roles, users, pages, languages, books and content moderation.
project_description: Drupal Test Assertions is a test-only helper library that ships eight PHPUnit assertion traits under the namespace Drupal\Tests\drupal_test_assertions\Assertions (files in tests/src/Assertions/). A functional or kernel test class `use`s the traits it needs and gains higher-level, Drupal-aware assertions instead of re-writing the same low-level checks in every project. The traits are: FieldsTrait (assertEntityTypeHasField, assertFieldIsHiddenInForm, assertFieldIsVisibleInForm, assertFieldIsRequired, assertFieldIsNotRequired, assertEntityReferenceTargetBundles, assertEntityReferenceTargetBundlesStrict), EntityTrait (assertEntityExists), RolesTrait (assertRoleExists, assertRoleHasPermissions), UsersTrait (assertNoCreateAccountsAllowed, assertUnprivilegedRolesCannotPerformRiskyActions), PageTrait (assertMetatag, assertRedirectedTo, assertUrlIs, assertStatusCode, assertPageContains, assertPageNotContains, plus the tryOrRepeat retry helper), LanguageTrait (assertLanguageExists), BookTrait (assertBooksAllowedInOutlines, assertBookChildPages), and ContentModerationTrait (assertModerationEnabledForEntityType, assertWorkflowForEntityType, assertWorkflowHasTransition, assertWorkflowNotHasTransition). The module contains no runtime code: no routes, permissions, services, config schema, hooks or .module file, so it imposes nothing on a production site and is normally required as a dev dependency. It has no declared module dependencies, though individual traits call core/contrib services (content_moderation, workflows, user, language, book, field) and are only meaningful when those modules are present.
